scopes.openprofile:edit: Correct an author's OpenProfile.md you have claimed: PUT /api/authors/{slug}/openprofile (text/markdown, the whole file, or a JSON patch), POST /api/authors/{slug}/claim. The grant's principal is recorded as the owner; a claim is verified by the address the author published or by their site linking back.
scopes.openwebring:edit: State who makes a site of yours that is in one of this host's webrings: PUT /api/rings/{ring}/members/{slug} with a JSON body { made_by: human | ai | both | null, disclosure }. Recorded as the owner's word, which a later read of the site's own /.well-known/openwebring.json never overwrites.
